description: PROPOSED immutable draft 2020-12 schemas; C:38–53,115–125,171–175. All object shapes closed and required. Freeze v3 §4 defines binding validation beyond JSON Schema: canonical hashes, authentication, reference resolution without cycles, state arithmetic, current observations, containment and durability are mandatory semantic checks. These schemas and catalog are static design, no real-pair acceptance. Acyclic typed argv bindings, physically independent R_rec recovery, three closed fencing variants; examples live at x-construction.examples so the standard draft 2020-12 examples annotation retains its array type.

BindingPlaceholder.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–119. Typed argv token; only a declared binding may replace it. A string such as ${self_sha256} is never a binding.

oneOf.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–119. Source is the complete owning unrendered profile, including this declaration and placeholders; source hash and rendered value both equal H.
PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–119. Exact JSON Pointer into one immutable named source record; selected value must be a nonempty string. No env/clock/implicit value source.

BindingDeclaration.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–119. One unique declaration per placeholder name in the owning profile; no undeclared or unused binding.

BoundValue.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–119. Value is read from the schema-validated source record at source_field. SELF uses owning profile hash and empty source_field; no copied hash authenticates a source.

InvocationBinding.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–119. Immutable receipt outside the owning profile. profile_sha256 hashes the unrendered profile; rendered_argv_sha256 hashes the canonical rendered string array. Every used name has exactly one source-bound value, including SELF. Consumers recompute template substitution and exact argv equality before trusting any process.

RecoveryLaunchContextRecord.description: PROPOSED; C:32,47,108–119. MAESTRO exclusive-creates this immutable launch input under R_rec/recovery before recovery spawn. recovery_epoch is a unique nonauthority enrollment epoch, not a claim about unreadable authority. context_mac authenticates canonical bytes excluding only context_mac with the distinct R_rec recovery key. No authority read/lock or permission.

NoPriorAuthorityFencingReceipt.description: PROPOSED; C:108–111,115–119. Initial provisioning only; no old_* fields exist. authority_store_capture_sha256 and independent_quiescence_capture_sha256 are raw-byte digests of complete successful independent observer captures in raw_receipts, proving authority store absent/empty and local quiescence. disable_all_record_sha256 resolves an immutable QUIESCE ActionReceipt proving all bulk entrypoints/dispatch/start releases disabled. Absence alone is never proof of no prior history; positive documented provisioning context and independent no-writer closure required.

MissingHistoryFencingReceipt.description: PROPOSED; C:51,79,108–119. Prior authority existed, identities unrecoverable; no old_* fields are invented or null. disable_all_record_sha256 resolves full QUIESCE disable-all ActionReceipt; independent_quiescence_capture_sha256 is the raw-byte capture digest bound by raw_receipts. Explicit MaestroApprovalReceipt covers this exact evidence and retained unresolved ownership inputs, not this receipt itself. Independent complete proof no writer/mutation capability survives is required before replacement; never early replacement. Unknown historical ownership remains exclusion.
